 Joe Milton Named Eagles QB1, Tanner McKee Benched Ahead of Giants Matchup Amid Jalen Hurts' Absence
 Joseph Zucker Nov 4, 2026 The Philadelphia Eagles are turning to Joe Milton as their starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the New York Giants, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Mike Garafolo .
 Philly is hopeful Milton can help snap a six-game losing skid before the team heads into its Week 10 bye.
